businesses.business: money transfers and retail payment services

offering_description.value: Provides international money transfers for individuals sending funds to family and friends, along with prepaid phone top-ups, bill payments, and money orders. Customers can send money online or through retail agents, with payouts available by bank deposit, mobile wallet, or cash pickup.

quotes.quote: These days, we feature an omnichannel approach because our customers demand it. We now offer as many ways as possible to send money. Our customers can send a wire at any of our retail locations, or they can send it online by using a debit card, credit card, or ACH.
